spellbook.finance/limitations: Only seller-approved fields are accepted. Omission preserves the stored field.
Null clears a selected channel override field and cannot clear the required baseline multiplier or floor.
The update saves configuration. It does not activate, publish or trigger repricing.

description: Update selected seller-approved fields on one pricing profile and return saved profile and pin readback. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Null clears only a selected channel override field.

floor.description: Channel floor override; null clears only this override.

marketOffsetUsd.description: Channel dollar adjustment; null clears only this override.

mult.description: Channel multiplier override; null clears only this override.

floor.description: Seller minimum price in USD for this value band. Omit to inherit the profile floor.

label.description: Seller label for this ordinary market-value band. Omit when unlabeled.

marketOffsetUsd.description: Seller dollar adjustment after the market multiplier. Omit for no adjustment.

maxUsd.description: Exclusive upper market value in USD. Omit for no upper bound.

minUsd.description: Inclusive lower market value in USD. Required.

mult.description: Seller multiplier for this value band. Required.

valueBands.description: Channel value bands; null clears only this override.

channelOverrides.description: Selected per-channel overrides; omit to preserve all, null to clear one channel entry.

profileId.description: The exact saved pricing profile id from a prior pricing profile read. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_pricing_profile_update
